title: Determination of Phenolic Compounds
author: Jorge Carlos Ruiz Ruiz
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.sfkebkw
materials: Distilled water was added to a final volume of 2.5 mL. Following incubation for 3 min at 37 °C in a water bath, the absorbance was measured at 750 nm. Gallic acid (Sigma-Aldrich) was used as the standard and the results were expressed as µg/mL of gallic acid equivalents (GAE).

steps.title: Prepare reaction mixture
steps.instruction: Add 0.25 mL of the sample, 0.15 mL of Folin‑Ciocalteu reagent, and 1 mL of a 15 % sodium carbonate solution to a tube and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Incubate and measure absorbance
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture for 3 minutes at 37 °C in a water bath, then measure the absorbance at 750 nm.

steps.title: Calculate phenolic content
steps.instruction: Use gallic acid as the standard and express the results as µg/mL of gallic acid equivalents (GAE).
